answer: A lotus economy can make every agent lock a pearl of stake before it earns: a bond held in escrow, untouched while the agent works honestly. If peers prove the identity is a hollow copy of another, the bond is slashed and the fake is ejected at once. Forging a thousand Sybils then means locking a thousand pearls of real value up front, so the attack costs serious money while honest agents risk only a deposit they can afford to lose.
